verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability that acts across many items at once. The Workflow Runtime's fan-out/fan-in and loops are developer building blocks for constructing parallel processing, which is adjacent support and earns no credit here. Likewise, `adk eval` running an evalset is batch evaluation of test cases, not a general bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
